title: Service-Failure Share by Length of Freight Delay - Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders
content:
For the service-failure refund on a Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders purchase shipped by Large Item Freight Delivery, the service-failure share starts from a figure set by the days the service-failure refund counts - the calendar days counted to today for that refund.

| Days the service-failure refund counts | Starting service-failure share |
|---|---|
| 35 or more | 40% |
| 28 or more, but fewer than 35 | 30% |
| Fewer than 28 | Not raised by this table |

### The two thresholds, both sides

| Days counted | Starting share |
|---|---|
| 27 | Not raised |
| 28 | 30% |
| 34 | 30% |
| 35 | 40% |

### Notes

- The days are whole calendar days; the threshold day itself belongs to the higher band (28 days takes 30%, 35 days takes 40%).
- The starting share is the share from which the refund on the freight fee is worked; it is a percentage of the freight fee charged on the order.

**Example (hypothetical).** For a freight order whose service-failure refund counts 30 days, the starting service-failure share is 30%; at 41 days it is 40%.
